description: Move the open local assembly into a new vault repo layout. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

vault_name.description: New vault repo name (local assembly only)

name: git_move_to_repo
